product: 高中英语课本章节同步训练
note: 人教版（2019 版）必修第一/二/三册 + 选择性必修第一~四册共 7 册 36 单元；每单元含重点词汇、语法要点与同步练习；词汇音频约定路径 /audio/sw/<word>.mp3（暂无则优雅降级）。必修第一册与各校首单元已充实，其余单元内容整理中。

units.title: Welcome Unit
units.topic: 高中生活启航 · 基础交际与校园词汇

words.sentence: As a freshman, he felt both excited and nervous.
words.sentenceCn: 作为高一新生，他既兴奋又紧张。

words.sentence: The campus is beautiful in autumn.
Learning a new language is a real challenge.
words.sentenceCn: 学习一门新语言是真正的挑战。

words.sentence: She is confident about the coming exam.
words.sentenceCn: 她对即将到来的考试很有信心。

words.sentence: We attended a lecture on science.
words.sentenceCn: 我们听了一场关于科学的讲座。

words.sentence: You must register for the new course.
He volunteers at the local library.
words.sentenceCn: 他在当地图书馆做志愿工作。

words.sentence: My goal is to study abroad.
University life makes students more independent.
words.sentenceCn: 大学生活让学生更独立。

words.sentence: We should be responsible for our own study.
words.sentenceCn: 我们应该对自己的学习负责。
我们来了解一下不同的社团吧。

grammars.point: 用情态动词 can / should / must 表达能力与建议：can 表能力，should 表建议，must 表必须。
grammars.example: You should join a club to make friends.
grammars.exampleCn: 你应该加入一个社团来交朋友。

grammars.point: 祈使句用于提出请求或建议，常以动词原形开头；否定式在句首加 Don't。
grammars.example: Don't be late for the first class.
grammars.exampleCn: 第一节课不要迟到。

questions.stem: 新学期你鼓励同学加入社团，最恰当的建议是：___
questions.analysis: should 用于给出建议，加入社团是积极建议。

questions.stem: "大一新生" 对应的英文是：___
questions.analysis: freshman 指中学或大学一年级新生。

questions.stem: — Can you concentrate on the lecture? — ___, it is very interesting.
questions.analysis: can 提问用 can 回答，表示能做到。

questions.stem: We should be ___ for our own learning.
questions.analysis: be 动词后接形容词 responsible（有责任的）。

questions.stem: He ___ at the school library every weekend.
questions.analysis: 主语 he 为第三人称单数，动词加 -s。

questions.stem: ___ late for the meeting.
questions.analysis: 祈使句否定式以 Don't 开头。

units.title: Unit 1 Teenage Life
units.topic: 青少年生活 · 学习与社团

words.sentence: I prefer reading to watching TV.
words.sentenceCn: 比起看电视，我更喜欢阅读。

words.sentence: This club is suitable for beginners.
We had a debate about school rules.
words.sentenceCn: 我们就校规进行了一场辩论。

words.sentence: She will attend the music club.
He quit the team last month.
We must learn to survive stress.
words.sentenceCn: 我们必须学会扛过压力。

words.sentence: There is a gap between two generations.

grammars.point: 宾语从句：由 that / whether / what 等引导，作动词的宾语；that 常可省略。
grammars.example: I think (that) this club is fun.
grammars.exampleCn: 我认为这个社团很有趣。

grammars.point: 一般现在时与一般过去时：描述常态用一般现在时，描述过去动作用一般过去时。
grammars.example: He joins the club. / He joined it last year.
grammars.exampleCn: 他加入社团。/ 他去年加入的。

questions.stem: I ___ reading books to playing games.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 后用动词原形 prefer。

questions.stem: This activity is ___ for new students.
questions.analysis: be suitable for 为固定搭配，意为"适合…"。

questions.stem: — Do you think ___ we should join the team? — Yes.
questions.analysis: think 后接 that 引导的宾语从句，that 可省略。

questions.stem: Teenagers often feel ___ from exams.
questions.analysis: feel 后接名词 pressure（压力）。

questions.stem: He ___ the club because he was too busy.
questions.analysis: 由 was 可知用一般过去时 quit（quit 过去式同形）。

questions.stem: ___, the homework is not so hard.
questions.analysis: actually 作状语，意为"实际上"。

units.title: Unit 2 Travelling Around
units.topic: 旅行计划 · 交通与预订

words.sentence: We had a long journey by train.
words.sentenceCn: 我们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。

words.sentence: Take a travel brochure with you.
We can rent a car there.
words.sentenceCn: 我们可以在那儿租一辆车。

words.sentence: We should plan a travel budget.
words.sentenceCn: 我们应该规划旅行预算。

words.sentence: Check your luggage at the counter.

words.sentenceCn: 这家酒店住宿条件很好。

grammars.point: 将来时态：be going to 表计划，will 表意愿或预测，现在进行时表已确定的近期安排。
grammars.example: I am going to visit Beijing.
grammars.exampleCn: 我打算去北京游玩。

grammars.point: 疑问词引导的宾语从句：what / where / how 等疑问词可引导宾语从句。
grammars.example: Could you tell me where the station is?
grammars.exampleCn: 你能告诉我车站在哪儿吗？

questions.stem: We are ___ to take a trip next week.
questions.analysis: be going to 表计划中的将来。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ the museum is?
questions.analysis: where 引导宾语从句，询问地点。

questions.stem: We can ___ a car at the airport.
questions.analysis: can 后接动词原形 rent。

questions.stem: The train ___ was cancelled because of the storm.
questions.analysis: train journey 意为"火车旅程"，用名词原形。

questions.stem: Don't forget to pack your ___.
questions.analysis: luggage 为不可数行李。

questions.stem: I paid for the ticket by ___ card.
questions.analysis: credit card 信用卡。

words.sentence: I jog in the park every morning.
words.sentenceCn: 我每天早晨在公园慢跑。

words.sentence: A daily workout keeps you fit.
words.sentenceCn: 每天锻炼让你保持健康。
她凭着极大的决心获胜。

grammars.point: 现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，表示过去发生并持续到现在的动作或影响。
grammars.example: He has trained for two years.
grammars.exampleCn: 他已经训练两年了。

grammars.point: 形容词、副词的比较级与最高级：单音节加 -er/-est，多音节用 more/most。
grammars.example: Running is healthier than sitting.
grammars.exampleCn: 跑步比久坐更健康。

questions.stem: He has ___ every morning this month.
questions.analysis: has + 过去分词 jogged 构成现在完成时。

questions.stem: Cycling is ___ than driving for short trips.
questions.analysis: than 提示用比较级 healthier。

questions.stem: The players ___ for their team loudly.
questions.analysis: 描述已发生的比赛用一般过去时 cheered。

questions.stem: You should keep a balanced ___ to stay fit.
questions.analysis: balanced diet 均衡饮食。

questions.stem: She showed great ___ to finish the race.
questions.analysis: great 后接名词 determination（决心）。

questions.stem: To ___ your body, try swimming twice a week.
questions.analysis: 不定式 to 后接动词原形 strengthen（增强）。

units.title: Unit 4 Natural Disasters
units.topic: 自然灾害 · 应急与报道

words.sentence: The earthquake was a terrible disaster.
words.sentenceCn: 那场地震是可怕的灾难。

words.sentence: The flood washed away the bridge.
They found shelter in a school.
words.sentenceCn: 他们在学校找到了避难所。

words.sentence: The survivors were sent to hospital.

words.meaning: 被掩埋的（bury 的过去分词）
words.sentence: Many houses were buried by the mud.
words.sentenceCn: 许多房屋被泥石流掩埋。

words.sentence: We should make an effort to help.
Food supplies were sent to the area.
words.sentenceCn: 食物补给被送往该地区。

grammars.point: 一般过去时被动语态：was/were + 过去分词，强调动作的承受者。
grammars.example: The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
grammars.exampleCn: 桥被洪水冲毁了。

grammars.point: 定语从句：that / which 指物，who 指人，在从句中作主语或宾语。
grammars.example: The soldiers who helped us were brave.
grammars.exampleCn: 帮助我们的士兵很勇敢。

questions.stem: The old house ___ by the earthquake last night.
questions.analysis: last night 用一般过去时；house 作主语用被动 was destroyed。

questions.stem: The man ___ saved the child was a firefighter.
questions.analysis: 先行词 man 指人，用 who 引导定语从句。

questions.stem: After the flood, food ___ were sent to the village.
questions.analysis: food supplies 意为"食物补给"，用复数。

questions.stem: The rescue team made every ___ to find survivors.
questions.analysis: make an effort / make every effort 努力。

questions.stem: Many people lost their homes in the ___.
questions.analysis: in the disaster 在灾难中。

questions.stem: They found ___ in a nearby school.
questions.analysis: find shelter 找到避难处。

units.title: Unit 5 Languages Around the World
units.topic: 世界语言 · 文化与沟通

words.sentence: He has a good command of English.

words.sentenceCn: 她提出了一个礼貌的请求。

words.sentence: English has a variety of accents.
words.sentenceCn: 英语有各种各样的口音。

words.sentence: He speaks with a British accent.
People there speak a local dialect.

grammars.point: 现在分词作定语或状语：表示主动、进行，如 speaking English（说英语的）。
grammars.example: The boy speaking English is my cousin.
grammars.exampleCn: 那个说英语的男孩是我表弟。

grammars.point: 主谓一致：集合名词或单数主语用单数动词，并列主语用复数。
grammars.example: English is useful. / Tom and Jerry are friends.
grammars.exampleCn: 英语很有用。/ 汤姆和杰瑞是朋友。

questions.stem: The girl ___ French fluently is from Paris.
questions.analysis: 现在分词 speaking 作定语，表主动。

questions.stem: He has a good ___ of three languages.
questions.analysis: have a good command of 熟练掌握。

questions.stem: English, Chinese and Arabic ___ widely used.
questions.analysis: 三个并列主语用复数 are。

questions.stem: A strong accent can be a communication ___.
questions.analysis: barrier 障碍。

questions.stem: She is ___ in both English and Japanese.
questions.analysis: be fluent in 在…方面流利。

questions.stem: Each culture is ___ and worth respecting.
questions.analysis: unique 独特的，作表语。

units.title: Unit 1 Cultural Heritage
units.topic: 文化遗产 · 保护与交流

words.sentence: The Great Wall is a world heritage.
We need a balance between work and rest.
words.sentenceCn: 我们需要工作与休息的平衡。

words.sentence: The site is worthy of protection.
Tourists contribute to the local economy.
words.sentenceCn: 游客为当地经济做贡献。

grammars.point: 介词 + which / whom 引导的定语从句：表物用 which，表人用 whom。
grammars.example: The temple in which they prayed is old.
grammars.exampleCn: 他们祈祷的那座庙很古老。

grammars.point: 被动语态：be + 过去分词，强调承受者或动作本身。
grammars.example: The site was protected by law.
grammars.exampleCn: 该遗址受法律保护。

questions.stem: We must ___ our cultural heritage for the future.
questions.analysis: must 后接动词原形 preserve。

questions.stem: The museum ___ in 1950 is famous.
questions.analysis: 过去分词 established 作定语，表被动完成。

questions.stem: This place is ___ of a visit.
questions.analysis: worthy of 值得…。

questions.stem: I ___ the local food to every visitor.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 后用动词原形 recommend。

questions.stem: Tourists ___ a lot to the economy.
questions.analysis: 复数主语用动词原形 contribute。

questions.stem: The old bridge was ___ by the flood.
questions.analysis: 被动语态 was destroyed。

words.sentence: We celebrate it with a big meal.
They decorate the house with lights.
We had a feast at night.
words.sentenceCn: 我们晚上吃了一顿盛宴。

words.sentence: What is the origin of this festival?
words.sentenceCn: 这个节日的起源是什么？

words.sentence: The harvest festival thanks the land.

grammars.point: 情态动词表推测：must 表肯定推测，can't 表否定推测，may 表可能。
grammars.example: He must be tired after the trip.
grammars.exampleCn: 旅途后他一定累了。

grammars.point: 名词性从句：what 引导主语/宾语/表语从句，表示"…的事物"。
grammars.example: What we need is time.
grammars.exampleCn: 我们需要的是时间。

questions.stem: Families ___ together during the Spring Festival.
questions.analysis: 复数主语用动词原形 gather。

questions.stem: He ___ be the owner — I saw him leave.
questions.analysis: can't 表否定推测，意为"不可能"。

questions.stem: They ___ the street with red flags.
questions.analysis: 描述已发生用过去时 decorated。

questions.stem: ___ we need most is a plan.
questions.analysis: what 引导主语从句，表"…的事物"。

questions.stem: The ___ of the festival is a harvest thanks.
questions.analysis: origin 起源。

questions.stem: We show ___ to our teachers.
questions.analysis: show gratitude 表达感激。

units.title: Unit 1 People of Achievement
units.topic: 杰出人物 · 传记与成就

words.sentence: He devoted his life to science.
He is generous with his time.

grammars.point: 非谓语动词：不定式 to do、动名词 doing、分词作状语/定语，使句子更简洁。
grammars.example: To succeed, you must work hard.
grammars.exampleCn: 要成功，你必须努力。

grammars.point: 定语从句：who / whom / whose 指人，在从句中分别作主、宾、定语。
grammars.example: The scientist whose theory changed the world was Einstein.
grammars.exampleCn: 改变世界的那位科学家是爱因斯坦。

questions.stem: He ___ his life to helping others.
questions.analysis: devote...to... 奉献于…；此处作谓语用过去时 devoted。

questions.stem: ___ succeed, you need to keep trying.
questions.analysis: 不定式 To succeed 作目的状语。

questions.stem: The writer ___ book won a prize is my friend.
questions.analysis: whose 在定语从句中作定语，表"…的"。

questions.stem: She is an ___ student in every way.
questions.analysis: outstanding 杰出的，作定语。

questions.stem: His ___ to medicine saved many lives.
questions.analysis: his 后接名词 contribution（贡献）。

questions.stem: We were ___ by her brave story.
questions.analysis: 被动语态 were inspired（被激励）。

words.sentenceCn: 他的理论改变了物理学。
他们发现了一颗新行星。

words.sentence: We concluded the test was valid.
words.sentenceCn: 我们得出结论：测试有效。

grammars.point: 现在完成时被动语态：have/has been + 过去分词，强调已完成且影响延续。
grammars.example: The theory has been proved.
grammars.exampleCn: 该理论已被证实。

grammars.point: 名词性从句作主语/宾语：what / that 引导，如 What he said is true.
grammars.example: That he was right has been shown.
grammars.exampleCn: 他是对的这一点已被证明。

questions.stem: The experiment has ___ successfully.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时被动 has been conducted。

questions.stem: They ___ a new way to treat the disease.
questions.analysis: 描述已发生用过去时 discovered。

questions.stem: We need more ___ to support the claim.
questions.analysis: more 后接名词 evidence（证据）。

questions.stem: His ___ changed how we see the universe.
questions.analysis: his 后接名词 theory（理论）。

questions.stem: The team ___ the study last year.
questions.analysis: last year 用过去时 conducted。

questions.stem: She ___ her findings in a journal.
questions.analysis: 她发表了发现，用过去时 published。

units.title: Unit 4 Journey Across a Vast Land

words.sentenceCn: 我们参观了一家美术馆。

words.sentence: The sculpture is made of stone.
He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.sentenceCn: 他画了一幅母亲的肖像。

grammars.point: 定语从句：that / which / who 引导，修饰名词，使描述更紧凑。
grammars.example: The painting which won the prize is famous.
grammars.exampleCn: 获奖的那幅画很有名。

grammars.point: 非谓语动词作定语：现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动。
grammars.example: The exhibited works attracted many visitors.
grammars.exampleCn: 展出的作品吸引了许多观众。

questions.stem: The museum ___ works by local artists.
questions.analysis: 主语 museum 单数，动词用 exhibits。

questions.stem: The painting ___ won a prize is by Picasso.
questions.analysis: 先行词 painting 指物，用 which 引导定语从句。

questions.stem: Art can ___ deep feelings.
questions.analysis: can 后接动词原形 convey（传达）。

questions.stem: This is a ___ of modern architecture.
questions.analysis: a masterpiece 杰作。

questions.stem: I prefer ___ art to classical art.
questions.analysis: contemporary art 当代艺术。

questions.stem: The ___ works were painted in the 19th century.
questions.analysis: 过去分词 exhibited 作定语，表被动。

words.sentence: Humans evolved over millions of years.
words.sentenceCn: 人类历经数百万年进化。
这个故事的前提很有趣。

grammars.point: 虚拟语气：if 引导的非真实条件句，表示与现在/过去事实相反的假设。
grammars.example: If I were an alien, I would explore Earth.
grammars.exampleCn: 如果我是外星人，我会探索地球。

grammars.point: 定语从句：that / which 修饰物，who 修饰人，在从句中作成分。
grammars.example: A world which has no war is our hope.
grammars.exampleCn: 没有战争的世界是我们的希望。

questions.stem: If I ___ an alien, I would visit another planet.
questions.analysis: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be 用 were。

questions.stem: The ___ landed on a distant planet.
questions.analysis: spacecraft 航天器，单复数同形。

questions.stem: AI means ___ intelligence.
questions.analysis: artificial intelligence 人工智能。

questions.stem: The novel's ___ is about time travel.
questions.analysis: premise 前提。

questions.stem: Humans ___ from ancient apes.
questions.analysis: 描述已发生用过去时 evolved。

questions.stem: A story ___ makes us think is good sci-fi.
questions.analysis: 先行词 story 指物，用 which 引导定语从句。
